title: What Cryogenic Logic Families Is
definition: Cryogenic Logic Families: superconducting logic at liquid-helium temperatures.
description:

Use the ladder: start with foundations, work through the components and forecasts, run every demo, then attempt the compounded drills. By the final record you will hold a working mental model of logic hulls, grounded in real research and honest about what remains unknown.

t: Real Research Today: Cryogenic Logic Families
title: Real Research Today: Cryogenic Logic Families
definition: Today's documented research behind Cryogenic Logic Families.
description:
The road to Cryogenic Logic Families is already being paved. Microsoft's Majorana program pursues topological qubits for fault-tolerant quantum computing. Reversible and adiabatic computing research (Sandia, Notre Dame) targets thermodynamic limits.

Cerebras wafer-scale chips pack trillions of transistors for AI training. Together these programs form the SFQ gates foundation that Cryogenic Logic Families will build on — the logic logistics results, the cryo packaging methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as logic logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Cryogenic Logic Families
definition: Estimates Cryogenic Logic Families readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Cryogenic Logic Families components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a logic hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Cryogenic Logic Families Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Cryogenic Logic Families: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Cryogenic Logic Families — superconducting logic at liquid-helium temperatures.

Phase 1 — Prove (SFQ gates): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (logic logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (cryo packaging): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (clock distribution): logic hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and supercomputers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
